title: Reserved confirmatory sequences (plan T3.R4)

rule.selection: catalogue fields only: tools/data/scan_catalogue.py --days 30 on the network's reviewed catalogue (no waveform, pick or detection read); availability from archive listings and StationXML only (tools/data/s3_availability.py)
criteria: networks not used for development or the atlas (CI, IV, N. Hi-net) and not used by any other reserved sequence as development data

origin times after the training period of the neural pickers of the comparator ledger (phasenet/original and phaseno: NCEDC 1984-2019; src/ttmt/associate/provenance.py); a regional overlap is declared

at least 400 catalogued events at or above max(Mc maximum curvature + 0.2, Mc goodness of fit 90 %) in the window, median horizontal error at most 1 km (3 km outside California), median azimuthal gap at most 180 deg
at least 8 stations with continuous three-component data within 50 km of the centre on a sampled day
rule.seal: the area is a disc of radius_km around (lat, lon) and the window is [start, end) UTC; every network and every station in the area is sealed for the window (ttmt.registry.check_read). Allowed before the phase-6 registration: fetching and hashing bytes, and QC metadata (headers, StationXML, catalogue aggregates). Not allowed: decoding samples, picks, detections, per-event catalogue entries.

sequences.name: The Geysers geothermal field, induced seismicity, March 2024
sequences.availability: 2024-03-15: 46 stations within 30 km, 41 with three components (BG DP* at 500 Hz, NC HH*/HN*), all with StationXML in the bucket
sequences.why: dense network (truth from the full network, evaluation on 4-12 station subsets: decimation design of CR-04); continuous induced sequence; network BG never used

sequences.name: Antelope Valley M6.0 aftershocks, July 2021 (California-Nevada border)
sequences.archive: NCEDC AWS open dataset (waveforms); NN StationXML from the EarthScope FDSN service (not in the bucket)
sequences.availability: 2021-07-15: no NC/BK station with StationXML in the bucket within 50 km; 31 NN stations in the bucket without StationXML. Metadata must come from EarthScope before QC; if fewer than 8 three-component stations pass QC, the sequence is replaced by conf_bodie_2020
sequences.why: tectonic aftershock sequence with time-varying completeness (short-term incompleteness); sparse regional network, the target geometry

sequences.name: Bodie / Mina area sequence, April 2020
sequences.archive: NCEDC AWS open dataset (waveforms); NN StationXML from EarthScope
sequences.availability: 2020-04-20: one NC station with StationXML within 60 km; relies on NN like conf_antelope_valley_2021
sequences.why: spare for conf_antelope_valley_2021 (same networks, so at most one of the two is used)

sequences.role: confirmatory (slot defined by rule, pending data access)
sequences.name: Colombian national network (SGC, CM): first sequence that meets the criteria
sequences.archive: Servicio Geologico Colombiano, FDSN network CM (doi:10.7914/SN/CM); access requested (plan T3.R6)
sequences.rule: run scan_catalogue.py --days 30 on the SGC catalogue for 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31 (catalogue fields only); the highest-ranked window that meets the criteria above (horizontal error at most 3 km) and has at least 8 three-component CM stations within 60 km is the sequence; it is added to this file by an amendment with its window, and its area is sealed from that commit on
sequences.why: a network outside California and outside every training set of the comparator ledger

excluded: Long Valley caldera swarm, September 2019 (NC): inside the training period of phasenet/original and phaseno (NCEDC 1984-2019); usable as development data only
Geysers 2023 and 2025 windows (BG): not used, so that BG stays a network never used for development
